Electronic Scoring & Target Systems

VTI supports SIUS electronic target systems for sport and institutional ranges. Solutions may include electronic targets, scoring and range-control components, competition software, result display and related accessories selected for the required discipline and facility.

Shooting Range & Training Systems

With BKE HITCOM, VTI supports indoor range and training technology covering visual scoring, static-target modules, interactive projection, simulation options and range infrastructure. Project scope is coordinated against the facility, training purpose and manufacturer specification.

Mechanical Targets & Range Infrastructure

BKE HITCOM’s published portfolio includes pop-up, turning, falling, spinning and mobile target systems with individual or automatic control, alongside screen units and bullet-trap solutions. VTI coordinates the relevant technical package and local support for an approved institutional project.

Clay Shooting Systems

LAPORTE manufactures clay-target launchers and targets for Olympic and universal trench, skeet, sporting, Compak, DTL, American Trap and training applications. VTI helps clients define equipment requirements, coordinate supply and plan local service.

Precision Sport Equipment & Accessories

Through J.G. ANSCHÜTZ and ahg-ANSCHÜTZ, VTI supports precision sport-shooting equipment and specialist accessories. Categories include target air and small-bore sporting equipment, shooting apparel, sights, bags, gloves, footwear, optics-related accessories and maintenance products.
